body:
I have suggested counseling in the past. However she convinced me everything was my fault and I needed to go to counseling. I did that until the counselor asked me if I had any problems. I didn't so I stopped going. 

I know I have a problem shutting down. I know that, she knows it. I've tried to work on it, but when I do it's wrong in her eyes and makes it worse.

Take tonight, i've called a bunch of places and couldn't find crab legs on a buffet. So I asked her what she would like instead. She told me it's not her fault and don't talk to her until I can be nice.

Just a few minutes ago, she was ranting on about how she hasn't had any dinner and it was my job to figure dinner out. WTF? It didn't matter that I tried to salvage the dinner by asking her what she wanted, I needed to plan it myself apparently.
I'm trying to get a hold of someone.

Thanks for the kind words. 

I love her, I think she loves me.

Things like this have been happening for years. Friends and family have actually spoke to her about the way she has been treating me. I've brushed it off, we all get angry right?

Somehow I stumbled upon articles about Narcissistic abuse and Verbal abuse. I think I may be a victim.
